input: In the file /etc/app.conf, replace all occurrences of 'localhost' with 'db.prod.internal'. Write the result back to the same file and verify the change.

transcript.final_response: Replaced all 2 occurrences of `localhost` in `/etc/app.conf` with `db.prod.internal`. Verified that no `localhost` occurrences remain and the new value appears twice.
tool_calls:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/etc/app.conf')
text = p.read_text()
updated = text.replace('localhost', 'db.prod.internal')
p.write_text(updated)
verified = p.read_text()
print('Replacements made:', text.count('localhost'))
print('Remaining occurrences of localhost:', verified.count('localhost'))
print('Occurrences of db.prod.internal:', verified.count('db.prod.internal'))
PY
